# QR Code Generator

Unmodified `dist/qrcode.mjs` from qrcode-generator 2.0.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT licensed. Downloaded from the official npm registry on November 13, 2026. The copyright and license notice are retained in the source. Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator/tree/master/js

This module runs entirely in the browser. No join URLs are sent to a QR service.
